method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，依据频道主题与证据信号筛选候选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Assessing the Reliability of LLM-Generated Phenotype-Genotype Associations Through External Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Phenotype-genotype associations underpin precision medicine by enabling disease prevention, early diagnosis, risk stratification, therapeutic target discovery, and personalized treatment. However, the rapid growth of scientific evidence has made manual curation of these associations increasingly labor-intensive, time-consuming, and incomplete. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a potential path to scalable genomic generation and synthesis of this knowledge, but their ability to accurately identify phenotype-genotype associations and the extent to which these outputs are supported by established genomic knowledge bases remain unclear. Materials and Methods: Four LLMs, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash Preview, and GPT-5.5, were benchmarked on six zero-shot task categories covering forward and reverse phenotype-gene and phenotype-SNP generation. A total of 4,196 associations were identified from curated inputs and evaluated through a multistage external verification pipeline comprising phenotype normalization, ontology mapping, genomic identifier validation against Ensembl, and evidence verification using both the GWAS Catalog and OMIM. Associations were assigned a fused evidence level of strong, moderate, weak, or none. Results: Overall, 74.19% of generated associations were matched to at least one external genomic knowledge base; 9.15% received strong support and 54.46% moderate support. Phenotype-gene associations were more verifiable than phenotype-SNP associations (strong or moderate: 67.19% vs 54.06%). Among existing associations, Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieved the highest overall strong or moderate rate (69.2%), followed by GPT-5.5 (65.1%), DeepSeek V4 Flash (61.7%), and Gemini 3 Flash Preview (56.9%). Conclusion: LLMs can support scalable generation of candidate phenotype-genotype associations. Performance varied substantially by relation type and was lower for SNP-level and rare disease associations, highlighting both the limitations of current genomic resources and the need for rigorous validation pipelines. Key words: large language model; clinical genomics; phenotype-genotype association; external validation; genomic knowledge base
items.summary_zh: 对四个 LLM 生成表型—基因及表型—SNP 关联的能力开展外部知识库验证；4,196 条关联中 74.19% 可匹配至少一个外部基因组知识库，但强证据比例仅为 9.15%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为将 LLM 用于临床基因组知识生成提供了可量化的外部验证范式，同时显示 SNP 层面和罕见病关联仍需严格核验。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：表型—基因型关联通过支持疾病预防、早期诊断、风险分层、治疗靶点发现和个体化治疗，构成精准医学的基础。然而，科学证据的快速增长使这些关联的人工整理愈发劳动密集、耗时且不完整。大语言模型（LLMs）为基因组知识的可扩展生成和整合提供了一条潜在路径，但其准确识别表型—基因型关联的能力，以及这些输出得到既有基因组知识库支持的程度，仍不清楚。材料与方法：在六类零样本任务上对 Claude Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3 Flash Preview 和 GPT-5.5 四个 LLM 进行了基准测试，任务覆盖正向和反向的表型—基因及表型—SNP 生成。从经整理的输入中识别出共 4,196 条关联，并通过多阶段外部验证流程进行评估，该流程包括表型标准化、本体映射、依据 Ensembl 的基因组标识符验证，以及同时使用 GWAS Catalog 和 OMIM 的证据验证。关联被赋予强、中等、弱或无的融合证据等级。结果：总体而言，74.19% 的生成关联与至少一个外部基因组知识库相匹配；9.15% 获得强支持，54.46% 获得中等支持。表型—基因关联比表型—SNP 关联更易验证（强或中等支持：67.19% 对 54.06%）。在已有的关联中，Claude Sonnet 4.6 的总体强或中等支持率最高，为 69.2%，其后依次为 GPT-5.5（65.1%）、DeepSeek V4 Flash（61.7%）和 Gemini 3 Flash Preview（56.9%）。结论：LLM 可支持候选表型—基因型关联的可扩展生成。性能因关联类型而显著不同，在 SNP 层面和罕见病关联上的表现较低，这凸显了当前基因组资源的局限性及严格验证流程的必要性。关键词：大语言模型；临床基因组学；表型—基因型关联；外部验证；基因组知识库
items.author_line: Sun, C., Xin, Y., Zeng, S. 等 10 人

items.title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
items.abstract_or_text: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.
items.summary_zh: Foresight-E 描述了一个基于约 6,100 万人去标识化纵向 NHS 电子健康记录训练的 2.43 亿参数生成式模型；数据访问暂停，当前未报告定量结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作公开了人群尺度 EHR 基础模型的编码、训练和评估设计，但尚不能据此判断预测效能或临床适用性。
items.abstract_zh: Foresight-England（Foresight-E）是首个国家尺度的电子健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，作为严格限于 COVID-19 研究的研究试点开发。我们评估了其刻画该疫情直接和间接影响的能力。Foresight-E 完全在 NHS England Secure Data Environment 内从头训练，是一个含 2.43 亿参数的 Transformer 解码器。它在约 6,100 万人的去标识化纵向 EHR 上训练和评估，整合了初级/二级医疗、死亡登记和 COVID-19 数据。训练和验证使用了 2018 年 11 月至 2022 年 12 月期间 90% 的数据子集（5,490 万人）；其余 10%（610 万人）留作评估。Foresight-E 以自回归方式建模患者时间线，根据既往病史预测下一医疗事件。在推理时，它以零样本方式运行，可在其约 40,000 个代码的词表中预测任意概念，无需任务特异性训练。我们的分词方案保留 ICD-10、OPCS-4 和 SNOMED CT 代码的临床粒度，并联合表示绝对和相对时间。我们设计了针对 30 天 COVID-19 住院和死亡的评估框架，包括按人口学因素和疫苗接种状态开展的亚组分析。为评估对未见未来数据的泛化能力及该疫情的间接影响，我们在 2023 年医疗事件上测试模型，将其与逻辑回归和 XGBoost 进行基准比较。正如项目状态部分所详述，NHS England 已暂停 Foresight-E 项目的数据访问，这意味着目前无法提供定量结果。作为替代，我们分享了分词、架构、训练、推理和评估策略，作为构建人群尺度 EHR 基础模型所面临挑战的方法学模板和案例研究。
items.author_line: Simon Ellershaw, Christopher Tomlinson, Zeljko Kraljevic 等 9 人

items.title: Phenotype-associated spatial biomarker discovery in spatial transcriptomics with spHOT
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics now profiles patient cohorts at single-cell resolution, enabling analysis of disease-associated cell organization in situ. However, discovering such spatial biomarkers remains challenging because relevant structures occur at unknown scales and cell- or niche-level annotations are rarely available. We present spHOT, a deep learning framework that localizes phenotype-associated spatial biomarkers from sample-level labels. spHOT combines spatial foundation model embeddings, a hierarchical domain tree for multi-resolution tissue representation, and a teacher-student multiple instance learning architecture that converts sample labels into cell-level biomarker scores. In controlled simulations and real-tissue benchmarks, spHOT outperformed existing spatial and single-cell methods in localizing ground-truth biomarkers. Across fibrotic, metabolic, and autoimmune disease datasets, spHOT recovered disease-relevant niches and tissue states reported by supervised analyses in the original studies. Cross-disease application of spHOT transferred biomarkers across chronic lung diseases without retraining. spHOT enables scalable, annotation-efficient spatial biomarker discovery in cohort-scale spatial transcriptomics.
items.summary_zh: spHOT 利用空间基础模型嵌入、层级组织域树和师生多实例学习，从样本级标签定位与表型相关的空间转录组标志物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法试图降低队列尺度空间转录组研究对细胞或微环境精细标注的依赖，并在多种疾病数据中报告了跨疾病迁移能力。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学现已能够以单细胞分辨率分析患者队列，从而可在原位研究与疾病相关的细胞组织结构。然而，发现这类空间生物标志物仍具挑战，因为相关结构出现于未知尺度，且细胞或微环境层面的注释很少可得。我们提出 spHOT，一个从样本级标签定位表型相关空间生物标志物的深度学习框架。spHOT 将空间基础模型嵌入、用于多分辨率组织表征的层级域树，以及把样本标签转化为细胞级生物标志物评分的师生多实例学习架构相结合。在受控模拟和真实组织基准中，spHOT 在定位真实标志物方面优于现有空间和单细胞方法。在纤维化、代谢和自身免疫疾病数据集上，spHOT 找回了原始研究中经监督分析报告的疾病相关微环境和组织状态。spHOT 在不重新训练的情况下，跨慢性肺病迁移了生物标志物。spHOT 支持在队列尺度空间转录组学中开展可扩展、标注高效的空间生物标志物发现。
items.author_line: Kim, H., Kim, D., Jung, S. 等 5 人

items.title: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Bone Lesions on CT Scans of Metastatic Spine Disease Patients: A 3D-Convolutional Neural Network Approach
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose: Clinical assessment of vertebral lesion quality (osteolytic, osteoblastic, mixed) remains subjective, with limited interobserver reliability. This study evaluated a novel application of 3D convolutional neural networks (3D-CNNs) for classifying lesion quality from CT volumes in metastatic cancer patients. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study used CT data from 151 cancer patients planned for radiotherapy for metastatic spine disease (September 2020-July 2024). Leveraging vertebra-level expert annotations, we introduced an unconventional U-Net-based strategy converting coarse voxel-wise predictions into vertebra-level lesion classifications. The final dataset comprised 2,125 vertebrae across four classes (no lesion, osteolytic, osteoblastic, mixed), split into a 3-fold cross-validation set and an independent holdout test set. Model performance was benchmarked against a DenseNet121 baseline and a musculoskeletal radiologist, with Cohen's kappa assessing inter-rater agreement. Results: The 3D model achieved an ensemble accuracy of 84.7%, outperforming DenseNet121 (72.1%), with substantial gains in F1 score, precision, and balanced accuracy. It showed high concordance with the radiologist (Cohen's kappa = 0.76) and comparable sensitivity and specificity across all lesion subtypes. We found both models and the radiologist to struggle with osteolytic lesions, reflecting the difficulty of distinguishing this class from age-related changes in vertebral bone density and architecture caused by benign bone lesions, age-related systemic skeletal disorders and cancer treatments. Conclusions: 3D-CNNs trained with vertebra-level labels can accurately and reliably classify vertebral metastatic lesion quality from CT scans, offering a scalable path toward automated characterization of metastatic spine disease to support clinical decision-making and large-scale radiomics research.
items.summary_zh: 在 151 名转移性脊柱疾病患者、2,125 个椎体的 CT 数据上，3D-CNN 对骨转移病灶质量分类的集成准确率为 84.7%，并与肌肉骨骼放射科医师高度一致。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了独立留出集和专家比较，但数据来自回顾性单一队列，应用于临床决策前仍需外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：椎体病灶性质（溶骨性、成骨性、混合性）的临床评估仍具有主观性，观察者间一致性有限。本研究评估 3D 卷积神经网络（3D-CNN）从转移癌患者 CT 体数据中对病灶性质进行分类的一种新应用。材料与方法：这项回顾性研究使用 2020 年 9 月至 2024 年 7 月期间计划接受放疗的 151 名转移性脊柱疾病癌症患者的 CT 数据。利用椎体级专家注释，我们引入一种非常规的基于 U-Net 策略，将粗略的体素级预测转化为椎体级病灶分类。最终数据集包括 2,125 个椎体，分为四类：无病灶、溶骨性、成骨性和混合性；数据被划分为 3 折交叉验证集和独立留出测试集。模型性能与 DenseNet121 基线和一名肌肉骨骼放射科医师进行比较，并以 Cohen's kappa 评估评分者间一致性。结果：3D 模型的集成准确率为 84.7%，优于 DenseNet121（72.1%），在 F1 分数、精确率和均衡准确率方面有显著提升。它与该放射科医师高度一致（Cohen's kappa = 0.76），并在所有病灶亚型上表现出可比的敏感度和特异度。我们发现，两种模型和该放射科医师均难以识别溶骨性病灶，这反映出此类病灶与由良性骨病变、年龄相关全身性骨骼疾病和癌症治疗导致的椎骨骨密度及结构年龄相关改变之间的区分难度。结论：使用椎体级标签训练的 3D-CNN 能够从 CT 扫描中准确、可靠地对椎体转移病灶性质进行分类，为转移性脊柱疾病的自动化表征提供了一条可扩展路径，可支持临床决策和大规模影像组学研究。
items.author_line: Hong, V., Bulent, A., Haouchine, N. 等 13 人

items.title: A Generative Virtual Tissue Model Enables Computational Design of Therapeutic Perturbation Strategies
items.abstract_or_text: Computational design has transformed many fields of engineering, where simulators can explore millions of candidate design configurations before experimental development and testing. Therapeutic design in biomedicine has resisted computational design approaches because disease progression and therapeutic response emerge from interactions among many cell types within human tissue, governed by biochemical parameters that are largely unknown and potentially unknowable. Here, we introduce the Cell Interaction Foundation Model (CIFM), a virtual tissue model that forward-simulates the transcriptional dynamics of cells in human tissue under arbitrary therapeutic conditions based upon a spatial transcriptomic seed. CIFM is a geometric graph neural network trained by self-supervised masked-transcriptome prediction on millions of cellular microenvironments spanning human tissue types and disease states; generative, auto-regressive, monte-carlo play-out, then, simulates transcriptional dynamics under combinatorial perturbations from a spatial transcriptomic seed. We validate CIFM by showing accuracy gains in gene expression prediction and imputation, disease classification, recapitulation of perturbation responses in prostate cancer models, and recovery of T cell-tumor signaling measured in cell-cell sequencing experiments. Beyond such conventional tasks, CIFM enables target identification and therapeutic design through generative tissue simulation play-outs. Analyzing over 10^6 single and combinatorial perturbations, CIFM designs immunotherapy strategies for cancer and autoimmune disease that exploit combinatorial manipulation of signaling pathways to induce or suppress immune activation. Broadly, CIFM shows how generative artificial intelligence methods can be applied to model emergent behavior in highly interacting biological systems, yielding new approaches to fundamental understanding of tissue behavior as well as large-scale therapeutic design.
items.summary_zh: CIFM 是以数百万细胞微环境自监督训练的虚拟组织模型，可从空间转录组种子模拟组合扰动下的转录动态，并在前列腺癌及细胞—细胞测序实验中开展验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将空间组织中的细胞相互作用用于大规模干预模拟具有方法学吸引力，但其治疗策略仍是计算产生的候选，不能替代功能和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 计算设计已改变许多工程领域，模拟器可以在实验开发和测试前探索数百万种候选设计配置。生物医学中的治疗设计一直难以采用计算设计方法，因为疾病进展和治疗反应源于人类组织内多种细胞类型之间的相互作用，而其生化参数大多未知，且可能无法获知。我们在此引入细胞相互作用基础模型（CIFM），这是一种虚拟组织模型，可基于空间转录组种子，在任意治疗条件下正向模拟人类组织中细胞的转录动态。CIFM 是一个几何图神经网络，在跨越人类组织类型和疾病状态的数百万个细胞微环境上，通过自监督掩蔽转录组预测进行训练；随后以生成式、自回归式蒙特卡洛模拟，从空间转录组种子模拟组合扰动下的转录动态。我们通过展示其在基因表达预测和插补、疾病分类、前列腺癌模型中扰动反应再现，以及细胞—细胞测序实验中测得的 T 细胞—肿瘤信号恢复方面的准确性提升，对 CIFM 进行验证。除这些常规任务外，CIFM 还可通过生成式组织模拟用于靶点识别和治疗设计。通过分析超过 10^6 种单一和组合扰动，CIFM 为癌症和自身免疫疾病设计免疫治疗策略，这些策略利用信号通路的组合操控来诱导或抑制免疫激活。总体而言，CIFM 展示了如何将生成式人工智能方法用于建模高度相互作用生物系统中的涌现行为，从而为组织行为的基础理解和大规模治疗设计带来新方法。
items.author_line: Lu, Y., Zhang, W., Chen, Y.-J. 等 12 人

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Clinically Aligned Adverse Event Coding in Acute Myeloid Leukemia Clinical Trials
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Adverse event (AE) coding is essential for safety monitoring in oncology clinical trials, particularly in acute myeloid leukemia (AML), where intensive therapies are associated with frequent and heterogeneous toxicities requiring standardized MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities) coding. However, manual Low-Level Term (LLT) assignment remains labor-intensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. Although large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising decision-support tools for automated coding, unguided zero-shot generation remains insufficient for reliable fine-grained MedDRA coding. Objective: To develop and evaluate a retrieval-augmented reasoning pipeline for clinically aligned LLT-level MedDRA coding of free-text adverse events from prospective AML clinical trials. Methods: We implemented a retrieval-augmented reasoning pipeline inspired by the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) paradigm using LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct as the primary backbone and benchmarked the framework across multiple open instruction-tuned LLMs. Dense semantic retrieval first generated a constrained top-100 LLT candidate set for each AE, followed by structured LLM reasoning to select a single best-matching LLT and deterministic mapping to Preferred Term (PT) and System Organ Class (SOC) levels. The pipeline was evaluated retrospectively on AE datasets from three prospective AML clinical trials (MOSAIC, DELTA, and DaunoDouble) with automated LLT/PT/SOC metrics and expert-assessed Clinical Correctness Rate (CCR). Results: Clinical expert review showed high clinical acceptability of the RAG pipeline across datasets (91-97%). Under automated evaluation, the pipeline achieved LLT exact accuracy of 50-58%, PT accuracy of 78-85%, and SOC accuracy of 90-93%. Zero-shot generation and random candidate selection performed substantially worse. Semantic retrieval more often included the coder-assigned LLT among the candidate terms available to the model than retrieval based on lexical similarity. Multi-model benchmarking showed that backbone choice mainly affected LLT exact agreement, whereas PT and SOC performance remained comparatively stable. Conclusions: Retrieval-augmented reasoning supports clinically aligned MedDRA coding of free-text adverse events under realistic candidate constraints in AML clinical trials. Evaluation across three AML clinical trials showed that strict LLT-level string agreement underestimated clinical ap-propriateness, highlighting the importance of combining hierarchical evaluation metrics with clini-cal expert validation for AI-assisted MedDRA coding in hematology trials.
items.summary_zh: 研究在 MOSAIC、DELTA 和 DaunoDouble 三项前瞻性 AML 临床试验的不良事件数据上，评估以 LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct 为主干的检索增强 MedDRA 编码流程；专家评审临床可接受率为 91–97%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 细粒度 LLT 的严格字符串一致率有限，而层级指标和专家评审较好，提示临床 NLP 评估应同时报告编码层级与临床适切性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：不良事件（AE）编码对于肿瘤临床试验的安全性监测至关重要，尤其是在急性髓系白血病（AML）中，强化治疗会带来频繁且异质的毒性，因而需要标准化的 MedDRA（监管活动医学词典）编码。然而，人工低级术语（LLT）分配仍然劳动密集、主观且难以扩展。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）已成为自动编码的有前景决策支持工具，但无引导的零样本生成仍不足以实现可靠的细粒度 MedDRA 编码。目的：开发并评估一种检索增强推理流程，用于对前瞻性 AML 临床试验中自由文本不良事件进行临床一致的 LLT 级 MedDRA 编码。方法：我们实施了一个受检索增强生成（RAG）范式启发的检索增强推理流程，以 LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct 为主要主干，并在多个开放指令微调 LLM 上对该框架进行基准测试。密集语义检索首先为每个 AE 生成受限的前 100 个 LLT 候选集，随后由结构化 LLM 推理选择唯一的最佳匹配 LLT，并确定性映射到首选术语（PT）和系统器官分类（SOC）层级。该流程在来自三项前瞻性 AML 临床试验（MOSAIC、DELTA 和 DaunoDouble）的 AE 数据集上回顾性评估，采用自动化 LLT/PT/SOC 指标和专家评估的临床正确率（CCR）。结果：临床专家评审显示，该 RAG 流程在各数据集上的临床可接受性较高（91–97%）。在自动化评估中，该流程的 LLT 精确准确率为 50–58%，PT 准确率为 78–85%，SOC 准确率为 90–93%。零样本生成和随机候选选择的表现明显更差。语义检索比基于词汇相似性的检索更常将编码员指定的 LLT 纳入模型可用候选术语中。多模型基准显示，主干模型选择主要影响 LLT 精确一致性，而 PT 和 SOC 性能相对稳定。结论：检索增强推理可在现实候选约束下支持对自由文本不良事件进行临床一致的 MedDRA 编码。对三项 AML 临床试验的评估表明，严格的 LLT 级字符串一致性低估了临床适切性，凸显在血液学试验的 AI 辅助 MedDRA 编码中结合层级评估指标和临床专家验证的重要性。
items.author_line: Dashti, N., Schneider, M. M. K., Eckardt, J. N. 等 11 人

items.title: Toward Better Assessment of LLMs' Performance in Clinical Error Detection
items.abstract_or_text: Automated detection of errors in clinical documentation is a promising application of large language models (LLMs), yet decisions to deploy such models rest on benchmarks that evaluate each clinical note in isolation. Error-detection benchmarks are typically constructed by injecting errors into notes, such that each erroneous note has a natural counterpart. Aggregate discriminative metrics (e.g., balanced accuracy or F1) do not exploit this structure. We show that this omission is consequential. In particular, evaluating 15 diverse LLMs on 4 standardized clinical error-detection test sets across 3 languages, we find that 13 of 15 models fall below the level of random pairwise discrimination, even while achieving F1 scores that standard practice would read as moderate. We also observe that the underlying bias patterns differ across languages: the same model can default to "no error" on one language and over-flag errors on another. To diagnose where discrimination breaks down, we further introduce a procedure to score the evidence models cite in their outputs. We find that while models consistently locate error-relevant content, they fail to produce the corresponding correct verdict on the clean counterpart. Finally, we show that F1 and pairwise accuracy are driven in opposite directions by the same underlying bias, so that ranking models by F1 may systematically promote the weakest discriminators. For safety-critical clinical NLP applications, we advocate for supplementing aggregate metrics with paired evaluations in benchmark reporting. Code and analysis scripts are available at https://github.com/healthylaife/paired-clinical-eval.
items.summary_zh: 在 3 种语言、4 个标准化临床错误检测测试集上评估 15 个 LLM 后发现，13 个模型的成对区分表现低于随机水平，尽管常规 F1 可显示中等水平。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作指出临床文本错误检测的聚合指标可掩盖系统性偏差，并提供了代码和分析脚本以支持更严格的配对评估。
items.abstract_zh: 自动检测临床文档中的错误是大语言模型（LLMs）很有前景的应用，但部署这类模型的决定依赖于将每份临床记录孤立评估的基准。错误检测基准通常通过向记录中注入错误来构建，因此每份错误记录都有一个自然对应的配对记录。聚合判别指标（如均衡准确率或 F1）没有利用这一结构。我们表明，这一遗漏后果重大。具体而言，在 3 种语言的 4 个标准化临床错误检测测试集上评估 15 个不同 LLM 后，我们发现 15 个模型中有 13 个的随机成对区分水平以下，尽管其 F1 分数按标准做法会被解读为中等。我们还观察到潜在偏差模式因语言而异：同一模型可能在一种语言中默认“无错误”，而在另一种语言中过度标记错误。为诊断区分在哪些环节失效，我们进一步引入一套流程，对模型在输出中引用的证据进行评分。我们发现，尽管模型能持续定位与错误相关的内容，却无法对干净的对应记录给出相应的正确判定。最后，我们表明，F1 和成对准确率会受到同一潜在偏差的相反方向驱动，因此按 F1 对模型排序可能系统性地推崇区分能力最弱的模型。对于安全关键的临床 NLP 应用，我们主张在基准报告中以配对评估补充聚合指标。代码和分析脚本见 https://github.com/healthylaife/paired-clinical-eval。

items.title: Early Detection of Erythropoietic Protoporphyria Using Sequential Machine Learning on Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: Erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP) is a rare photodermatosis marked by multi-year diagnostic delays. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to identify patients with EPP earlier from longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data and estimate undiagnosed disease burden. Materials and Methods: In a retrospective case-control study at two San Francisco health systems, an academic referral center (UCSF) and a safety-net hospital (ZSFG) we identified 74 confirmed EPP cases using combined diagnostic coding, biochemical criteria, and specialty chart review. Symptom-enriched controls were sampled at a 40:1 ratio. Longitudinal diagnoses, laboratory results, medications, procedures, and encounters preceding the outcome date were modeled with a gradient-boosting classifier (CatBoost) and a state-space sequence model (MAMBA). The best model was deployed across the UCSF population and externally validated at ZSFG without retraining. Results: On the UCSF held-out test set (n=1,865; 43 cases), MAMBA outperformed CatBoost (AUC ROC 0.91 vs 0.89; average precision 0.42 vs 0.27; precision 65% vs 20%), flagging cases a median of 229 days before documented diagnosis. Deployed across 297,967 symptom-compatible patients, it identified 310 high-risk individuals, implying a prevalence approaching genetic estimates. External validation at ZSFG showed attenuated performance (AUC ROC 0.72; average precision 0.10) while preserving early detection (median 264 days). Discussion: A sequence model integrating temporal EHR signals detected EPP months before clinical recognition, corroborating genetic evidence of substantial underdiagnosis. Cross-site attenuation reflects population and documentation differences and underscores the need for local recalibration. Conclusion: Longitudinal EHR-based machine learning can shorten EPP diagnostic delay and prioritize patients for confirmatory testing, supporting proactive rare-disease case finding.
items.summary_zh: 在两个旧金山医疗系统中，纵向 EHR 序列模型 MAMBA 对红细胞生成性原卟啉症进行早期识别；在外部站点性能下降，但仍可较记录诊断提前中位 264 天。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 罕见病病例识别同时报告了外部验证和跨站点性能衰减，说明模型可能用于确认检测前的筛选优先级，而非直接诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：红细胞生成性原卟啉症（EPP）是一种罕见光敏性皮肤病，常出现长达数年的诊断延迟。我们开发并外部验证了机器学习模型，以从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）数据中更早识别 EPP 患者，并估计未诊断疾病负担。材料与方法：在旧金山两个卫生系统，即学术转诊中心 UCSF 和安全网医院 ZSFG，开展回顾性病例对照研究；我们结合诊断编码、生化标准和专科病历审查，识别出 74 例确诊 EPP 病例。按 40:1 比例抽取症状富集对照。使用梯度提升分类器（CatBoost）和状态空间序列模型（MAMBA），对结局日期前的纵向诊断、实验室结果、用药、操作和就诊信息建模。最佳模型部署于 UCSF 人群，并在无需重新训练的情况下于 ZSFG 外部验证。结果：在 UCSF 留出测试集（n=1,865；43 例病例）中，MAMBA 优于 CatBoost（ROC AUC 0.91 对 0.89；平均精确率 0.42 对 0.27；精确率 65% 对 20%），并在有文档记录的诊断前中位 229 天识别出病例。部署到 297,967 名症状相容患者后，该模型识别出 310 名高风险个体，推示患病率接近遗传学估计。ZSFG 的外部验证显示性能减弱（ROC AUC 0.72；平均精确率 0.10），但仍保留早期识别能力（中位 264 天）。讨论：整合时间性 EHR 信号的序列模型能在临床识别前数月检出 EPP，与大量漏诊的遗传学证据相吻合。跨站点性能减弱反映了人群和文档记录差异，并强调本地重新校准的必要性。结论：基于纵向 EHR 的机器学习可缩短 EPP 诊断延迟，并将患者优先安排至确证性检测，从而支持主动的罕见病病例发现。
items.author_line: Ayati, A., Onal, G., Sur, A. 等 6 人

items.title: PanoraOnc: A pan-cancer clinico-genomic AI model for transferable outcome predictions
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in precision oncology, including biomarker discovery and individualized treatment selection, is limited by the complexity of clinico-genomic data and the scarcity of large multimodal patient cohorts. Here, we introduce PanoraOnc, a pan-cancer artificial intelligence (AI) model pretrained on real-world clinical, genomic, and imaging data from 84,131 patients spanning 66 cancer types. PanoraOnc enables transferable treatment outcome prediction through pan-cancer pretraining and generalizes to unseen cohorts across cancer types, institutions, and therapeutic settings. Evaluation and fine-tuning were performed on cohorts comprising diverse modalities, including clinical features, targeted gene panels, immunofluorescence imaging, whole-exome sequencing, and transcriptomic profiles. Across these settings, PanoraOnc consistently outperforms statistical, machine-learning, survival, and AI baselines, with the largest improvements observed in zero- and few-shot scenarios, demonstrating that large-scale clinico-genomic pretraining enables robust and generalizable outcome predictions across previously unseen conditions. In addition, PanoraOnc supports biomarker discovery through explainable AI, revealing both established and underappreciated features, including tumor-infiltrating clonal hematopoiesis, oncogenic signaling pathways, and DNA damage response mechanisms in immunotherapy-treated melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer. Furthermore, PanoraOnc enables the identification of patient subgroups potentially benefitting from alternative treatments by estimating personalized treatment outcomes across therapeutic scenarios. These findings establish pan-cancer multimodal pretraining as a scalable paradigm for AI-assisted discovery in precision oncology.
items.summary_zh: PanoraOnc 在 84,131 名、66 种癌症患者的真实世界临床、基因组与影像数据上预训练，作者报告其可迁移至未见队列和治疗场景的结局预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模多模态泛癌训练有望提高小样本情境下的预测迁移性；个体化治疗获益和生物标志物结论仍来自模型估计，需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 精准肿瘤学的进展，包括生物标志物发现和个体化治疗选择，受到临床—基因组数据复杂性及大型多模态患者队列稀缺的限制。我们在此引入 PanoraOnc，一种泛癌人工智能（AI）模型，在 66 种癌症、84,131 名患者的真实世界临床、基因组和影像数据上预训练。PanoraOnc 通过泛癌预训练支持可迁移的治疗结局预测，并可泛化到跨癌种、机构和治疗场景的未见队列。评估和微调在包含多样化模态的队列上进行，包括临床特征、靶向基因面板、免疫荧光成像、全外显子组测序和转录组谱。在这些情境中，PanoraOnc 一贯优于统计学、机器学习、生存分析和 AI 基线；最大的改善出现在零样本和少样本情境，表明大规模临床—基因组预训练能够在此前未见的情境中实现稳健、可泛化的结局预测。此外，PanoraOnc 通过可解释 AI 支持生物标志物发现，揭示了已知和此前未被充分关注的特征，包括在接受免疫治疗的黑色素瘤和非小细胞肺癌中的肿瘤浸润性克隆性造血、致癌信号通路和 DNA 损伤反应机制。PanoraOnc 还可通过在不同治疗情景下估计个体化治疗结局，识别可能从替代治疗中获益的患者亚组。这些发现确立了泛癌多模态预训练作为精准肿瘤学中 AI 辅助发现的可扩展范式。
items.author_line: Schuerch, M., Geisberg, J., Flower, C. T. 等 13 人

items.title: PerturbLDM: conditional latent diffusion for modelling single-cell perturbation responses
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell perturbation profiling maps intervention-induced phenotypes, yet experiments measure only a fraction of the perturbation-context space. Learning context-dependent perturbation effects could enable response prediction beyond measured conditions. Here we introduce PerturbLDM, a latent-diffusion framework for conditional generation of single-cell transcriptional responses. Following Tahoe-100M pretraining, it predicted 13,942 held-out combinations of observed drugs, doses and cell lines more accurately than existing methods, with higher matched-control effect correlation than an additive marginal baseline in 95.2% of conditions. The Tahoe-100M-pretrained model was further used to rank PANACEA compounds by pathway similarity, placing shared-mechanism pairs among nearest neighbours. In smaller datasets, PerturbLDM generated a mid-gestational fetal-colon state with 67% lower gene-wise error than Squidiff, retaining the balance between absorptive and BEST4/OTOP2-like epithelial programmes. In PBMCs, it captured six of seven interferon and antiviral programmes and the interferon-associated FAO-OXPHOS programme more accurately than scGen. Together, these results support conditional response generation across data scales and biological settings.
items.summary_zh: PerturbLDM 以 Tahoe-100M 预训练的条件潜在扩散模型生成单细胞转录扰动反应，在 13,942 个留出药物—剂量—细胞系组合及多个小型数据场景中报告优于现有方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试外推实验未覆盖的扰动—细胞背景组合，并以药物、胎儿结肠和 PBMC 任务检验跨数据尺度表现。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞扰动分析能够绘制干预诱导的表型，但实验仅测量扰动—背景空间的一小部分。学习依赖背景的扰动效应，可能支持对未测量条件下反应的预测。我们在此引入 PerturbLDM，一个用于条件生成单细胞转录反应的潜在扩散框架。经过 Tahoe-100M 预训练后，它对 13,942 个留出的已观测药物、剂量和细胞系组合的预测比现有方法更准确，并且在 95.2% 的条件下，其匹配对照效应相关性高于加性边际基线。经 Tahoe-100M 预训练的模型还用于按通路相似性排列 PANACEA 化合物，将共享机制的化合物对排在最近邻中。在较小数据集上，PerturbLDM 生成了一个妊娠中期胎儿结肠状态，其逐基因误差比 Squidiff 低 67%，同时保留吸收型和 BEST4/OTOP2 样上皮程序之间的平衡。在 PBMC 中，它比 scGen 更准确地捕捉了七个干扰素和抗病毒程序中的六个，以及干扰素相关 FAO-OXPHOS 程序。总体而言，这些结果支持跨数据尺度和生物学情境的条件反应生成。
items.author_line: Yu, L., Hsieh, K.-L., Chu, Y. 等 13 人

items.title: AFilter: Improved Antibody Epitope Prediction by Machine Learning-Optimized Interface Energy Filtering of AlphaFold3-Predicted Complex
items.abstract_or_text: AlphaFold3 (AF3) predicts protein-complex structures from sequence with near-experimental accuracy on many targets, substantially lowering the cost of mechanistic and therapeutic discovery. However, application to antibody epitope prediction is hampered by an approximately 63% failure rate. Comparing successful and failed AF3 predictions across antibody-antigen and nanobody-antigen complexes, we found that failed predictions share a distinctive energetic signature: distorted CDR-loop geometries and elevated van der Waals strain at the interface. Building upon these observations, we developed a machine learning-based interface energy filtering framework, designated AFilter, capable of eliminating over 90% of erroneous predictions while retaining >90% of true positives. Compared with ipTM-based filtering, AFilter improved accuracy from 82.7% to 97.7% for nanobody-antigen complexes and from 79.4% to 96.3% for antibody-antigen complexes, while simultaneously raising the true positive rate from 69.8% to 96.4% and from 63.1% to 92.5%, respectively. When applied to NeuroMab antibodies of unknown structure, AFilter prioritized high-confidence epitope predictions that AF3 sampling alone could not reliably surface. As a lightweight post-hoc filter (<5% computational overhead) that requires no re-docking, AFilter is directly compatible with existing AF3 prediction pipelines and, in principle, transferable to other diffusion-based complex predictors, providing a practical quality-assurance layer for antibody epitope mapping in early-stage drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: AFilter 从 AlphaFold3 预测复合物的界面能量特征筛除错误抗体—抗原构象；作者报告在纳米抗体和抗体体系中均大幅提高表位预测准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该轻量级后处理器可改善 AF3 用于早期表位定位时的质量控制，但结果仍需以独立结构或结合实验检验。
items.abstract_zh: AlphaFold3（AF3）可从序列预测蛋白质复合物结构，并在许多靶点上达到接近实验的准确度，显著降低机制和治疗发现的成本。然而，其在抗体表位预测中的应用受到约 63% 失败率的阻碍。通过比较抗体—抗原和纳米抗体—抗原复合物中成功与失败的 AF3 预测，我们发现失败预测共享一种独特的能量特征：扭曲的 CDR 环几何形状和界面上升高的范德华应变。在这些观察基础上，我们开发了一个基于机器学习的界面能量过滤框架，命名为 AFilter，可在保留超过 90% 真阳性的同时剔除超过 90% 错误预测。与基于 ipTM 的过滤相比，AFilter 将纳米抗体—抗原复合物的准确率从 82.7% 提高至 97.7%，将抗体—抗原复合物的准确率从 79.4% 提高至 96.3%；同时，真阳性率分别从 69.8% 提高至 96.4%，以及从 63.1% 提高至 92.5%。应用于结构未知的 NeuroMab 抗体时，AFilter 优先筛出 AF3 单独采样无法可靠发现的高置信度表位预测。作为一种无需重新对接、计算开销低于 5% 的轻量级后处理过滤器，AFilter 可直接兼容现有 AF3 预测流程，并且原则上可迁移至其他基于扩散的复合物预测器，为早期药物发现中的抗体表位定位提供实用的质量保证层。

items.title: SPARKLE: evidence-constrained correction of local RNA leakage in high-resolution spatial transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: High-resolution sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics, including Stereo-seq and Visium HD, aggregates dense capture units into cell-resolved expression matrices. During tissue processing and permeabilization, RNA released from source cells can spread to neighbouring capture locations, reducing cell-type specificity and biasing downstream analyses. Here we developed SPARKLE (Spatial Ambient RNA Kernel-based Leakage Estimator), a cell-level correction method that uses capture locations outside cell-segmentation masks as within-sample spatial evidence of leakage. SPARKLE fits sparse spatial kernels to out-of-mask observations to estimate a sample-level propagation scale and gene-specific leakage coefficients. It corrects only genes supported by out-of-mask goodness of fit and uses expression-dependent conservative shrinkage to protect highly expressing source cells. Across ten simulated scenarios, SPARKLE achieved the highest cell-wise concordance and the lowest RMSE in 9 of 10 scenarios. In axolotl brain, mouse brain and human ovarian cancer, SPARKLE removed ectopic marker signal from neighbouring cells while retaining source-cell expression, improved agreement with independent single-cell and single-nucleus references, and recovered COL1A2-SDC4 signaling of fibroblast origin that collagen diffusion had obscured. Conclusions remained stable across plausible spatial scales and background-bin sizes. Runtime scaled near-linearly with tissue-window area, and was further acceleration on GPU. SPARKLE is therefore a reference-free, fast and scalable method for correcting local RNA leakage from evidence contained within each sample, improving the reliability of cell-type localization, tissue-compartment identification and cell-cell communication inference.
items.summary_zh: SPARKLE 利用细胞分割掩膜外捕获位点的样本内空间证据，校正高分辨率空间转录组中的局部 RNA 泄漏，并在 10 种模拟和三类组织中进行评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RNA 泄漏会扭曲细胞类型定位和细胞通讯推断；该方法在保持来源细胞高表达信号的同时开展保守校正，并强调计算可扩展性。
items.abstract_zh: 包括 Stereo-seq 和 Visium HD 在内的高分辨率测序型空间转录组学，将密集捕获单元聚合为细胞分辨率的表达矩阵。在组织处理和透化期间，从来源细胞释放的 RNA 可扩散至邻近捕获位置，降低细胞类型特异性并使后续分析产生偏差。我们在此开发了 SPARKLE（Spatial Ambient RNA Kernel-based Leakage Estimator），一种细胞级校正方法，它将细胞分割掩膜外的捕获位置用作样本内 RNA 泄漏的空间证据。SPARKLE 对掩膜外观测拟合稀疏空间核，以估计样本级传播尺度和基因特异性泄漏系数。它仅校正由掩膜外拟合优度支持的基因，并使用依赖表达量的保守收缩来保护高表达来源细胞。在十种模拟情景中，SPARKLE 在 10 种情景中的 9 种实现最高细胞级一致性和最低 RMSE。在美西螈脑、小鼠脑和人卵巢癌中，SPARKLE 从邻近细胞去除了异位标志物信号，同时保留来源细胞表达；它提高了与独立单细胞和单核参考的吻合度，并恢复了此前被胶原蛋白扩散遮蔽的、成纤维细胞来源的 COL1A2-SDC4 信号。结论在合理的空间尺度和背景 bin 大小范围内保持稳定。运行时间随组织窗口面积近似线性增长，并可通过 GPU 进一步加速。因此，SPARKLE 是一种无参考、快速且可扩展的方法，可利用每个样本所含证据校正局部 RNA 泄漏，提高细胞类型定位、组织区室识别和细胞—细胞通讯推断的可靠性。
items.author_line: Wang, S., Zhu, B., Li, S. 等 4 人

items.title: Prospective Validation of a Deep Learning Model to Detect Structural Heart Disease from Apple Watch ECGs: The WATCH-SHD Study
items.abstract_or_text: Importance: Consumer wearables such as the Apple Watch can record single-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) but are used mainly to detect rhythm disorders. Artificial intelligence-enhanced ECG (AI-ECG) could extend these real-world recordings for detecting structural heart disease (SHD), yet prospective validation remains limited. Objective: To prospectively validate a previously developed, noise-adapted AI-ECG model for detecting severe SHD from single-lead Apple Watch ECGs. Design: Prospective cohort study. Setting: Yale New Haven Hospital echocardiography laboratory. Participants: Adults aged >=18 years undergoing outpatient transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) as part of routine clinical care. Exposure: A 30-second, single-lead Apple Watch ECG recorded during the TTE visit and processed through an end-to-end, HIPAA-compliant platform for real-time AI-ECG inference. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcome was discrimination for TTE-defined severe SHD, a composite of left ventricular systolic dysfunction (left ventricular ejection fraction <40%), severe left-sided valvular disease, and/or severe left ventricular hypertrophy, assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Secondary measures were sensitivity, specificity, negative predictive value (NPV), and positive predictive value (PPV) at prespecified thresholds, and screening efficiency, assessed by the number needed to test (NNT) under usual-care versus AI-ECG-guided strategies. Results: Among 596 participants with analyzable Apple Watch ECGs (median age, 62 years [IQR, 46-72]; 51.2% women), severe SHD was present in 30 (5.1%). The model discriminated severe SHD well (AUROC, 0.841; 95% CI, 0.761-0.921), with a sensitivity of 76.7% (59.1-88.2), specificity of 83.2% (79.9-86.1), NPV of 98.5% (97.0-99.3), and PPV of 19.7% (13.5-27.8) at the prespecified threshold. An AI-ECG-guided strategy reduced the NNT to identify one case by more than 60% versus usual care across the composite and individual SHD phenotypes. Conclusions and Relevance: In this prospective cohort, a noise-adapted AI-ECG algorithm identified SHD phenotypes from real-world single-lead Apple Watch ECGs and improved screening efficiency. These findings support a potential role for wearable ECG-based screening in the scalable identification of clinically actionable SHD.
items.summary_zh: WATCH-SHD 在 596 名前瞻性队列参与者中验证基于单导联 Apple Watch ECG 的 AI-ECG 严重结构性心脏病识别，AUROC 为 0.841，阴性预测值为 98.5%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究有前瞻性采集和明确的超声终点，但阳性预测值仅为 19.7%，其筛查策略对不同人群和临床流程的净获益仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 重要性：Apple Watch 等消费级可穿戴设备可记录单导联心电图（ECG），但主要用于检测心律失常。人工智能增强心电图（AI-ECG）可将这些真实世界记录扩展用于检测结构性心脏病（SHD），但前瞻性验证仍有限。目的：前瞻性验证一个此前开发且适配噪声的 AI-ECG 模型，用于从单导联 Apple Watch ECG 检测严重 SHD。设计：前瞻性队列研究。地点：Yale New Haven Hospital 超声心动图实验室。参与者：在常规临床治疗中接受门诊经胸超声心动图（TTE）的年龄不低于 18 岁成人。暴露：在 TTE 就诊期间记录的一份 30 秒单导联 Apple Watch ECG，并通过端到端、符合 HIPAA 标准的平台进行实时 AI-ECG 推理。主要结局和测量：主要结局为对 TTE 定义的严重 SHD 的区分能力，该复合终点包括左心室收缩功能不全（左心室射血分数 <40%）、严重左侧瓣膜病和/或严重左心室肥厚，以受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估。次要指标为预设阈值下的敏感度、特异度、阴性预测值（NPV）和阳性预测值（PPV），以及筛查效率，即在常规治疗和 AI-ECG 引导策略下发现一例病例所需检测人数（NNT）。结果：在 596 名具有可分析 Apple Watch ECG 的参与者中（年龄中位数 62 岁［IQR，46–72］；女性占 51.2%），30 人（5.1%）存在严重 SHD。该模型对严重 SHD 的区分表现良好（AUROC，0.841；95% CI，0.761–0.921）；在预设阈值下，敏感度为 76.7%（59.1–88.2），特异度为 83.2%（79.9–86.1），NPV 为 98.5%（97.0–99.3），PPV 为 19.7%（13.5–27.8）。在复合终点和各个 SHD 表型中，与常规治疗相比，AI-ECG 引导策略使识别一例病例所需 NNT 降低超过 60%。结论和相关性：在这个前瞻性队列中，一种适配噪声的 AI-ECG 算法从真实世界单导联 Apple Watch ECG 中识别出 SHD 表型，并提高了筛查效率。这些发现支持可穿戴 ECG 筛查在可扩展识别具有临床可操作性 SHD 方面具有潜在作用。
items.author_line: Aminorroaya, A., Vasisht Shankar, S., Carter, M. 等 12 人

items.title: FluoroFate: A generalisable platform for time-resolved single-cell analysis of cell fate enables quantification of cell death dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Fundamental cellular decisions of life and death are governed by intricate and tightly regulated intracellular signalling pathways that determine whether cells proliferate, enter quiescence, or undergo programmed cell death (apoptosis). Live-cell fluorescence imaging enables these processes to be observed in real time at single-cell resolution, but two problems limit their study. First, existing biosensors do not allow apoptotic status and cell cycle progression to be resolved in tandem within the same cell. Second, interpreting live-cell imaging data is challenging even where multiplex reporters exist, as the biological meaning of fluorescent signals depends on their temporal ordering, and large-scale imaging experiments generate complex, multidimensional data that are difficult to analyse systematically and at scale. Here we address both problems. We present FluoroFate, a generalisable and user-friendly graphical interface-driven tool for time-resolved single-cell analysis of multiplex live-cell imaging datasets, which integrates existing, robust deep learning-based segmentation, cell tracking, and temporal classification methods to quantify fluorescent reporter dynamics in individual cells across time without the need for specialist computational expertise. Alongside FluoroFate, we develop tricistronic Fluorescent Ubiquitination-based Cell Cycle Indicator (Fucci) and apoptosis biosensors, enabling simultaneous monitoring of cell cycle progression and caspase activation within the same cell. Applying FluoroFate, we resolve apoptotic and non-apoptotic cell death at the single-cell level based on the temporal ordering of Annexin V and propidium iodide signals, identifying distinct kinetic and phenotypic cell death profiles in response to pharmacological perturbation. We highlight divergent temporal dynamics and modes of cell death between birinapant and cycloheximide treatment, reflecting differences in how TNF/TNFR1 signalling is disrupted by these agents. At the single-cell level, we uncover parallel, independently regulated death programmes, demonstrating that loss of RIPK1 selectively impairs apoptotic cell death whilst leaving non-apoptotic death largely unaffected. We then use FluoroFate to analyse timelapse images of our combined Fucci-apoptosis reporters, resolving cell cycle progression and caspase activation within the same cell over time. Together, FluoroFate and our new cell cycle and apoptosis biosensors represent a broadly applicable platform for extracting mechanistic insight from live-cell imaging data.
items.summary_zh: FluoroFate 将深度学习分割、细胞追踪和时间分类整合为图形界面，并配套三顺反子 Fucci—凋亡生物传感器，用于实时单细胞命运和死亡动力学分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 平台把细胞周期和 caspase 激活置于同一细胞的时间序列中观察，可提高活细胞成像研究对药物扰动和死亡程序的可解释性。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞生与死的基本决策由复杂且受到严格调控的细胞内信号通路决定，这些通路决定细胞是增殖、进入静息，还是发生程序性细胞死亡（凋亡）。活细胞荧光成像能够实时、以单细胞分辨率观察这些过程，但两个问题限制了其研究。第一，现有生物传感器无法在同一细胞中同时解析凋亡状态和细胞周期进程。第二，即使存在多重报告系统，活细胞成像数据仍难以解释，因为荧光信号的生物学意义取决于其时间顺序，而大规模成像实验会产生难以系统化、规模化分析的复杂多维数据。我们在此同时解决这两个问题。我们提出 FluoroFate，一个通用且用户友好的图形界面驱动工具，用于对多重活细胞成像数据集进行时间分辨单细胞分析。它整合既有且稳健的基于深度学习的分割、细胞追踪和时间分类方法，从而无需专业计算专长即可定量单个细胞随时间变化的荧光报告信号。除 FluoroFate 外，我们还开发了三顺反子荧光泛素化细胞周期指示器（Fucci）和凋亡生物传感器，使得可在同一细胞中同时监测细胞周期进程和 caspase 激活。应用 FluoroFate 后，我们依据 Annexin V 和碘化丙啶信号的时间顺序，在单细胞水平解析凋亡性和非凋亡性细胞死亡，并鉴定出对药物扰动作出反应的不同死亡动力学和表型谱。我们揭示了 birinapant 与 cycloheximide 治疗之间不同的时间动态和细胞死亡方式，这反映了这些药物扰动 TNF/TNFR1 信号的方式差异。在单细胞层面，我们发现相互平行、独立调控的死亡程序，表明 RIPK1 缺失选择性损害凋亡性细胞死亡，而在很大程度上不影响非凋亡性死亡。随后，我们使用 FluoroFate 分析组合 Fucci—凋亡报告系统的延时图像，解析同一细胞随时间变化的细胞周期进程和 caspase 激活。总体而言，FluoroFate 及我们的新型细胞周期和凋亡生物传感器构成一个广泛适用的平台，可从活细胞成像数据中提取机制性见解。

review.note: 已审阅完整 60 项候选。入选 16 项均为 preprint；本批没有标为 peer_reviewed 或 clinical 的候选。临床相关研究仍应视为预印本证据，尤其需关注外部验证、前瞻性评估与真实部署表现。
